header.title: Help & Documentation
header.subtitle: Learn how to use Docfai to create professional documentation

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.description: Docfai is a powerful documentation tool that helps you create step-by-step guides, tutorials, and process documentation using screenshots and video recordings.
quickStart: Create your first project from the Dashboard
Choose between Screenshots or Video Recording mode
Export your documentation in your preferred format

trial.title: Free Trial & Subscription
trial.trialDesc: Docfai offers a 7-day free trial with full access to all features—no credit card required.
trialFeatures: Full access to all documentation features
Access to all export formats (PDF, Word, HTML, etc.)
No credit card required to start
trial.afterTrialDesc: When your trial ends, you can choose from our subscription plans:
trial.subscriptionInfo: Visit the Pricing page to subscribe or manage your subscription from the Account page.

projects.title: Creating Projects
projects.projectDesc: Projects are containers for your documentation. Each project can contain multiple recordings and exports.
createSteps: Enter a project name and optional description
actions: Open: View and manage recordings within the project
Delete: Remove the project and all its recordings (irreversible)
Export: Export all recordings in the project at once

screenshots.title: Interactive Screenshots
screenshots.screenshotDesc: The Screenshots mode allows you to capture individual steps with full editing capabilities.
howToSteps: Navigate to Screenshots from the sidebar
Select or create a project
Click "Take Screenshot" or press the hotkey (default: F8 or Ctrl+Shift+C )
The screen capture will open in the editor automatically
Annotate with rectangles, arrows, text, blur effects, and more
Add a title and description for the step
Save the screenshot to your recording
editingTools: Text Box: Add custom text annotations
Crop: Trim the screenshot to focus area
shortcuts: Space + Drag: Pan around the image

videoRecording.title: Video Recording
videoRecording.recordingDesc: Record your screen to capture complex processes, then convert them into step-by-step screenshots.
howToSteps: Go to Recording from the sidebar
Select or create a project
Click "Start Recording"
Choose your screen or application to record
Perform the steps you want to document
Click "Stop Recording" when done
extractSteps: After recording, the video player will appear
Scrub through the timeline to find the exact frame
Click "Take Screenshot" at each important step
Each screenshot opens in the editor for annotation
Save to build your documentation sequence
tips: Move slowly and deliberately through each step
Pause briefly between actions to make screenshot extraction easier
Keep the recording focused on one process at a time
Use the video timeline's frame-by-frame controls for precision

templates.title: Templates
templates.templatesDesc: Templates control how your documentation looks when exported. Choose from professional templates or customize your own.
available: Professional: Clean, corporate-friendly design with structured layout
Modern: Contemporary design with vibrant colors and modern typography
Technical: Detailed template for technical documentation with code blocks
templates.customizeDesc: On the Export page, you can customize:
customizeOptions: Title & Description: Add document header information
Colors: Customize primary and accent colors
Typography: Choose fonts for headings and body text
Layout: Adjust spacing, margins, and structure
templates.saveDesc: Click "Save Template Settings" to remember your customizations for future exports.

export.title: Export Formats
export.exportDesc: Export your documentation in multiple formats to share with your team or integrate into your workflow.

pdf.name: PDF
pdf.desc: Professional PDF documents with images and formatted text. Perfect for sharing and printing.

docx.name: Microsoft Word (.docx)
docx.desc: Editable Word documents with images and formatting. Great for collaborative editing.

html.name: HTML
html.desc: Web-ready HTML with embedded images. Ideal for knowledge bases and internal wikis.

markdown.name: Markdown (.md)
markdown.desc: Plain text with Markdown formatting. Perfect for GitHub, GitLab, and technical documentation.

video.name: Video (.mp4)
video.desc: Slideshow video from screenshots with configurable duration per slide.

howToSteps: Go to Export from the sidebar
Select the project and recording to export
Choose your template and customize if needed
Select the export format(s)
Click "Export"
Choose the save location on your computer

importExport.title: Import Export Documentation
importExport.importDesc: Import previously exported projects or documentation from other sources. Export your current projects for backup or sharing.
howToSteps: Go to Import from the sidebar
Click "Choose File" or drag and drop files
Select the project to import into (or create a new one)
Click "Import"
The imported content will be added to your project
useCases: Collaborate with team members by sharing project files

connections.title: Cloud Integrations
connections.connectionsDesc: Connect Docfai to your cloud platforms to publish documentation directly.
connections.confluenceDesc: Publish documentation directly to Atlassian Confluence.
confluenceSteps: Enter your Confluence site URL (e.g., yourcompany.atlassian.net)
Enter your email and API token from Confluence settings
connections.usingDesc: Once connected, you can export directly to these platforms from the Export page:
usingSteps: Choose "Publish to Confluence" or "Publish to SharePoint"

backup.title: Backup & Settings
backup.backupDesc: Docfai automatically backs up your projects to ensure your documentation is never lost.
automaticSteps: Projects are saved locally on your computer in real-time
All changes are automatically persisted to disk
Encrypted storage ensures your data is secure
No internet connection required for local backups
configureSteps: Choose a folder on your computer or external drive
Set backup frequency (e.g., every hour, daily)
backup.manualDesc: You can manually export projects as backups:
manualSteps: Save the file to your backup location
restoreSteps: Your project will be restored with all recordings
settingsOptions: Theme: Switch between Light and Dark mode
Screenshot Hotkey: Customize the global hotkey for screenshots
Auto-save Interval: Configure how often projects are saved
Default Export Format: Set your preferred export format

translation.title: Translation Module
translation.translationDesc: Docfai offers offline document translation between English and German using a separate Translation Module that is downloaded on demand.
howItSteps: When you select a translation language during export, you will be prompted to download the Translation Module (~600 MB)
The module is downloaded once and stored locally on your computer
All translations happen offline - no internet connection is needed after the initial download
No document data is sent to external servers - everything stays on your machine
storageInfo: Location: Stored in your AppData folder (Docfai/translation-module)
translation.privacyNote: Privacy: The Translation Module uses Argos Translate, an open-source offline translation engine. Your documents are never sent to any external service. All processing happens locally on your computer.

footer.helpDesc: Can't find what you're looking for? Ask a question or report a bug on GitHub.
